checklist.title: Setup checklist
checklist.intro: Patients can book and join queues once every step is done and the facility goes live.
checklist.allDone: Every step is done. You can go live.
checklist.readyBody: Everything is ready. Going live makes the facility visible to patients.
checklist.notReadyBody: Finish the steps marked “To do” first.
checklist.liveBody: Patients can find you, book visits and join queues.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: How your facility works: what you offer, when, at what price, and who works here.

profile.title: Facility profile
profile.description: Contact details, location, photos and description.

services.title: Services and rooms
services.description: Departments, services with ticket prefixes, rooms and desks.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: Weekly hours, closures and the calendar patients see.

schedules.title: Doctor schedules
schedules.description: Each doctor's weekly sessions and leave.

tariffs.title: Prices
tariffs.description: The price list, with changes from a date.

insurers.title: Insurers
insurers.description: What each insurer covers and the patient's share.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Queue, booking, billing, documents and reminders.

history.title: Change history
history.description: Who changed which setting, and when.

displays.title: Waiting-room screens
displays.description: Links for the TV that shows ticket numbers.

profile.intro: Patients see this on your public page.
profile.name: Name
profile.platformManaged: Name and type come from your approved application. Ask MediLink support to change them.
profile.locationUnavailable: Your location is not available. Type the coordinates instead.
profile.outsideRwanda: These coordinates are outside Rwanda. Check them.
profile.descriptionHint: A few sentences in each language: what you treat and how to find you.
profile.photosHint_one: {{count}} of 6 photos. JPEG, PNG or WebP.
profile.photosHint_other: {{count}} of 6 photos. JPEG, PNG or WebP.

catalogue.intro: Services are what patients book or queue for. Each has a ticket prefix, such as G for G-023.
catalogue.noServices: Add the first service patients can book or queue for.
catalogue.noDepartments: Departments group your services, for example General OPD or Pediatrics.
catalogue.noPoints: Add the rooms and desks where patients are seen or served.

hours.intro: Set your weekly hours, then add closures. The preview shows what patients will see.
hours.inherits: This service follows the facility hours until you save its own.
hours.order: The end must be after the start.
hours.breakOrder: The break must end after it starts.
hours.breakInside: The break must sit inside opening hours.
hours.previewHint: Hours minus closures, public holidays and Umuganda.
hours.eventsHint: One-off changes to the weekly hours.
hours.noEvents: Add a closure for a training day, an inventory day or a holiday you do not open on.
hours.dateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.

schedules.intro: Each doctor's weekly sessions. Bookable slots come from these sessions.
schedules.overlap: This overlaps another session of the same doctor.
schedules.unattested: Attest this doctor's licence before adding sessions.
schedules.noDoctors: Invite a doctor, then attest their licence to plan sessions.
schedules.noExceptions: Requests from doctors appear here for your decision.

mine.title: My schedule
mine.intro: Your sessions this week and your leave requests.
mine.requestHint: Your facility admin approves or rejects it.
mine.noLeave: Requests you send appear here with their decision.
mine.noSchedule: Your facility admin has not planned your sessions yet.

tariffs.intro: Prices in Rwandan francs. A change starts on a date you choose; earlier visits keep the old price.
tariffs.name: Name
tariffs.empty: Add a price for each service so patients see costs before they come.

insurers.intro: For each insurer: what it covers here and what the patient pays.
insurers.excluded: Items the insurer does not pay
insurers.empty: Add the insurers you accept, or switch on “no insurers” in the billing rules.

rules.intro: Fine-tune how queues, bookings, payments, documents and reminders work here.
rules.billingStepUp: Billing changes ask you to confirm it is you.

queue.show_names_on_display: Show names on the waiting-room screen

booking.no_show_strikes: Missed visits before booking is paused

rules.brandingHint: The footer printed on receipts, prescriptions and letters.

history.intro: Every configuration change, newest first. Personal data is never recorded here.
history.empty: Changes appear here as soon as someone saves a setting.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Who works here, what they can do, and pending invitations.
staff.inviteHint: They get an email link valid for 7 days.
staff.none: Clear the search or the role filter.
staff.noInvites: Invite colleagues with the button above.
staff.deactivateHint: They are signed out at once and can no longer work here. You can reactivate them later.
staff.lastAdmin: The facility needs at least one admin. Give the role to someone else first.

done.mfa-reset: Two-step sign-in reset. They set it up again at their next login.

clinician.title: My professional licence
clinician.intro: Your council and licence number appear on prescriptions and records you sign.
clinician.reattest: Changing your council or licence number means your facility admin attests it again.

invite.title: Join a facility on MediLink
invite.invalid: The invitation link is not valid or has expired. Ask the facility for a new one.
invite.existingHint: You already have a MediLink staff account. Log in to accept.
invite.newHint: Create your account. Next you set up two-step sign-in.
